comment: dokick.c kick_nondoor() terrain branches: a lawful Samurai (debug mode, Friday the 13th so Luck is -1) wishes a grave, tree, sink, throne and altar around the bottom-left corner of the start room. Levitating on a ring with the corner walls to brace against, the kicks at the grave and the altar are kick_dumb() (1067-1069, 1100). Blindfolded, repeated kicks break the headstone (1115 lawful penalty, 1123 'Crack!  Something broke!'), destroy the throne (1028, Luck < 0) and raise a black pudding from the sink unseen (1213-1214). Each kick is followed by a 10-turn search so wounded legs heal; doubled escapes clear --More-- and the 'Call a scroll' prompt a nearby monster's reading opens.
